name: bauhaus-riot
vibe: A print poster that came alive. Warm cream paper, bold primary-color geometry (circles, triangles, squares), a dotted halftone texture, hard offset shadows, sticker stamps and a numbered sheet masthead. Heavy Archivo Black display over Space Grotesk mono chrome. NO gradients, NO glows, NO blur — the motion is stamps that snap flat, shapes that drop and bounce, curtain wipes and marching dashes. Rendered as a native GSAP + SVG/CSS composition. Best for bold, confident, editorial, design-forward brands.
